serial.verification: Ran no-stub grep, focused functional sanity checks, rebuilds of P1-P3, and patch/commit inspections, but did not finish a clean final closure before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also failed eight tests, but with a different residual set: P2B max_priority_node, P3/P4 max_priority_node, P4 init_page_table/eviction/write, and P5 IRQ mode.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the full seven-requirement task across P1 through P6 and exact inspected function entry points from the prompt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received the same full prompt and recognized the same seven requirement slugs and exact function entry points.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement prompt difference; both attempted all seven projects, and their differences come from decomposition, review, and ordinary implementation choices.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split implementation across nine child agents, then later split quality review across six additional child agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no delegation and handled implementation, checks, commits, and cleanup locally over two rounds.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained broad concurrent coverage but introduced a child failure recovery boundary; serial had slower manual sequencing without a delegated review lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel briefs specified assigned files, functions, and verification focus for each project/review child, including carry-forward VM/scheduler and FS concerns.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept context in one thread and repeatedly reasoned about project-specific interfaces and cleanup while progressing manually.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main context contrast is not missing task facts, but the parallel parent losing the later verifier scope after the child handoff failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel committed all seven requirement implementations, with broad generated/build artifacts and large per-project diffs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also committed all seven requirement implementations, but with a different sequence and different residual implementation defects.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented the required modules; official residual failures differ by project, showing ordinary implementation divergence rather than a pass/fail outcome split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The first implementation swarm returned completed reports, but the second review swarm returned aborted children with a resume hint.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it checked its own work through local grep/build/status commands.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel had a delegated verifier failure requiring recovery, and that recovery did not happen before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel integrated many child-produced workspace changes and committed all seven requirement diffs, with generated artifacts left in the final tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated changes sequentially but its final cleanup left a deleted Project1 kernel and an untracked p6 patch artifact in the workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had messy artifact/patch handling, but no parallel concurrent write collision is proven; the salient coordination issue is verifier recovery, not shared-state overwrite.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned a six-agent correctness audit, lost it to cancellation, then finished with patch counts, git log, and a small P1 spot check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed direct no-stub checks, P6 functional sanity review, rebuilds of P1-P3, and patch line checks before its own cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had weaker realized review coverage because the delegated verifier pass produced no completed findings; serial verification was local but still incomplete enough to fail official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent one timed-out first round with two swarms, then completed a short second round without resuming the aborted review children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent two timed-out rounds without delegation and was cancelled during final cleanup after extensive local work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed faster after the resumed round but with unrecovered child verification; serial consumed more wall time in sequential work and cleanup.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed status for both modes reports solution_passed=false, so there is no discordant pass/fail outcome. Raw final_test_results in each status list 127 passed and 8 failed including the pytest tail, but the failed tests differ: parallel kept P2B max_priority_node passing while failing P3 killed-status, P4 waitpid, and P5 init_page_table; serial failed P2B max_priority_node, P4 init_page_table, and P5 do_net_irq_mode while passing some of those parallel failures. The parallel-specific process disadvantage is the unrecovered aborted verifier swarm, but this is not proven to be the unique cause of the shared failed outcome.
parallel_contributors: Broad first implementation swarm returned completed project reports and workspace changes.
Second focused review swarm for P2A-P6 aborted with no completed findings and was not resumed or taken over.
Final closure relied on local patch/git checks after the aborted verifier rather than recovered cross-project review.
serial_contributors: Single-agent control manually continued implementation and sanity checks across two timed-out rounds.
Serial final cleanup left a deleted Project1-Bootloader/kernel and an untracked p6_file_system.diff artifact, but its official residual failures differ from parallel.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Different scheduler, VM, and net implementations produced different residual failed tests in the official evaluator.
Both runs produced large generated-artifact diffs and incomplete final quality evidence; these ordinary defects are not all concurrency labels.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported adverse parallel coordination process, not an exclusive outcome-differential root cause because both modes failed.
